title: The Drowned Crown
author: Marguerite Delacroix
blurb: Casper Sterling, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
